# {{ site.Title }} Documentation

> {{ site.Params.description }}

The Things Stack is an enterprise LoRaWAN® Network Server by The Things Industries. It is available as
The Things Stack Cloud (hosted), The Things Stack Enterprise (self-hosted), The Things Stack Sandbox
(formerly The Things Network) and The Things Stack Open Source. Current version: {{ site.Params.version }}.

Every page is also available as Markdown: append `index.md` to the page URL, as in the links below.
The full text of all guides is in {{ "llms-full.txt" | absURL }}.
